calculators.name: Die Casting - Net Material Usage
calculators.description: Finished part metal: CAD part volume x alloy density (memory/Die Casting materials_master).

calculators.name: Die Casting - Gross Material Usage
calculators.description: Charged metal: the part metal x the alloy Yield Loss Factor. Overflow, runner and gating metal is remelted in-house, not charged.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Shot Volume
calculators.description: High pressure die casting shot: every cavity plus its overflow (tblOverflowDim) plus the runner feeding it (runner height = thickest wall + additionalRunnerThickness, width = runnerAspectRatio x height, one ingate per ingateGap of part length).

calculators.name: Die Casting - Clamp Force
calculators.description: Clamp a high pressure die must hold: every cavity projected area x alloy clamping pressure x clampForceSafetyFactor.

calculators.name: Die Casting - High Pressure Die Casting
calculators.description: One shot = (machine dry cycle + ladle + lube + eject + fill + solidification) x cycleTimeAdjustmentFactor; per part = shot / cavities.

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: {Solidification Constant} * (({Injection Temp} - {Liquidus Temp} + {Percent Solids} * {Latent Heat Constant}) / ({Liquidus Temp} - {Mold Temp})) * {Wall Nominal}

fields.name: Shot Time
fields.formula: ({Dry Cycle Time} + {Ladle Fill Time} + {Lube Time} + {Eject Time} + {Fill Time} + {Solidification Time}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Gravity Die Casting
calculators.description: One pour = (dry cycle + ladle + lube + fill + solidification + drop + core load) x cycleTimeAdjustmentFactor / Mold Efficiency; per part = pour / cavities. Shot volume from the gravity metal yield.

fields.name: Shot Time
fields.formula: ({Dry Cycle Time} + {Ladle Fill Time} + {Lube Time} + {Fill Time} + {Solidification Time} + {Gravity Drop Time} + {Core Load}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor} / {Mold Efficiency}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Melting
calculators.description: Melted metal per part (the shot shared across cavities) x the ductile-iron melter Conversion Cost x regionConvFactor; the furnace must hold the batch melt x furnaceCapacitySafetyFactor.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Trim
calculators.description: Per part = trim press Cycle Time / defaultNumberOfTrimmedParts parts per stroke.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Trim Force
calculators.description: Force to shear the flash off along the parting line: perimeter x flash thickness (tblGrindingDimensions) x alloy Shear Strength.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Finishing
calculators.description: Grind the parting-line flash (perimeter x tblGrindingDimensions thickness x height) and, on a pressure die, the ingate stubs (ingate area = runner area x ingateAreaToRunnerArea, x Ingate Height), each at the machine grinding speed x the alloy Cut Code factor.

fields.name: Ingate Area
fields.formula: ({Wall Max} + {Additional Runner Thickness}) ^ 2 * {Runner Aspect Ratio} * {Ingate to Runner Area}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Cleaning
calculators.description: Shot blast: parts per load = min(floor(Weight Capacity / part weight), Max Batch Size); per part = Time per Load / parts per load.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Visual Inspection
calculators.description: Part surface area x the tblVisualInspection External Inspection Rate of the first weight band at or above the part weight.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Coremaking
calculators.description: One core per corebox blow: per part = core machine Base Cycle Time x cores.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Core Sand
calculators.description: Core sand used per part: core volume x sand density x sand New Cost (the Core Sand Type of the coremaker).

calculators.name: Die Casting - Core Refractory Coat
calculators.description: Core area / the tblRefractoryCoating Application Rate of the default method x defaultNumCoreRefractoryCoatingApplications.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Refractory Coat Air Dry
calculators.description: Loads of part core sets (by box volume, at most the batch) x defaultAirDryAndCoolTime, spread over the batch.

fields.name: Parts per Load
fields.formula: min(floor({Bed Length} * {Bed Width} * {Bed Height} / {Core Set Box Volume}), {Batch Size})

calculators.name: Die Casting - Refractory Coat Oven Dry
calculators.description: Loads of part core sets (by box volume x defaultRefractoryCoatOvenSpaceAvailableFactor, at most the batch) x defaultOvenDryAndCoolTime, spread over the batch.

fields.name: Parts per Load
fields.formula: min(floor({Bed Length} * {Bed Width} * {Bed Height} * {Space Available Factor} / {Core Set Box Volume}), {Batch Size})

calculators.name: Die Casting - Slide
calculators.description: One slide, sized by its bundle width (small / medium / large SlideVolume and SlideDesignTime): H13 weight and the design, CNC, pocket, assembly, spotting and inspection hours.

fields.name: Slide Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Slide CNC Rate} * {Slide Volume} + {Slide Setup} + {Pocket CNC Rate} * {Slide Volume} + {Pocket Setup}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Die Size
calculators.description: The die block: the cavity layout plus the edge borders each side (pressure die: tblEdgeMoldBorderX/Y for the press force; gravity die: edgeBorderPM), the part depth along the pull plus the cavity and core half depth borders, in H13.

fields.name: Die Depth
fields.formula: {Pull Extent} + {Cavity Half Depth Border} + {Core Half Depth Border}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Die Build
calculators.description: The die build: design / cavity machining / cooling / assembly hours and the bought components (ejector and guide pins, sprue bushing, spreader, locating ring), slides included, and the steel to buy.

fields.name: Parting Line Design Time per Slide
Hours per Square Inch
fields.column: Hrs Per Sq Inch Simple (hr / in^2)
alsoColumns: Hrs Per Sq Inch Average (hr / in^2)
Hrs Per Sq Inch Complex (hr / in^2)

fields.name: Cooling Channels
fields.formula: {Cavity Plate Water Rows} + {Core Plate Water Rows}

fields.name: Cooling Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Gun Drill Setup} + {Cooling Channels} * {Die Length} / 25.4 / {Waterline Drill Speed} / 60 + {Gun Tap Setup} + {Cooling Channels} * {Gun Tap Time} / 60 + {Counterbore Setup} + {Cooling Channels} * {Counterbore Time} / 60

fields.name: Design Hours
fields.formula: {Base Design Time} + {Per Slide Design Time} * {Slides} + {Parting Line Base Design Time} + {Parting Line Design Time per Slide} * {Slides} + max({Min Water Channel Design Time}, {Cooling Channels} * {Water Channel Design Time}) + {Slide Design Hours}

fields.name: Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Cavity Machining Hours} + {Cooling Machining Hours} + {Slide Machining Hours}

fields.name: Ejector Pins
fields.formula: ceil({Cavities} * {Projected Area} / 645.16 / {Projected Area per Ejector Pin})

fields.name: Assembly Hours
fields.formula: {Ejector Pins} * {Ejector Pin Assembly Time} + {Guide Pins} * {Guide Pin Assembly Time} + {Pressure Die} * (2 * {Sprue Assembly Time} + {Locating Rings} * {Locating Ring Assembly Time}) + {Slide Assembly Hours} + IF({Slide Assembly Hours} > 0, {Slide Inspection Setup}, 0)

fields.name: Component Cost
fields.formula: {Ejector Pins} * {Ejector Pin Cost} + {Guide Pins} * {Guide Pin Cost} + {Pressure Die} * ({Sprue Bushing Cost} + {Sprue Spreader Cost} + {Locating Rings} * {Locating Ring Cost})

calculators.name: Die Casting - Die Cost
calculators.description: One die: (H13 steel + heat treat + bought components + tool shop hours x the Default tool shop rates) x (1 + percentTuning + percentSGandA + percentProfit).

fields.name: Heat Treat Cost
fields.formula: {Total Steel Weight} * {Heat Treat Cost per kg} * {Heat Treat Calibration}

fields.name: Labour Cost
fields.formula: {Design Hours} * {Design Rate} + {Machining Hours} * {Machining Rate} + {Assembly Hours} * {Assembly Rate}

calculators.name: Die Casting - Die Life
calculators.description: Dies the production needs (lifetime shots / tblToolLife shots per die) and the tooling per part: a replacement die reuses the design.

calculators.name: Die Casting - Corebox
calculators.description: Coreboxes for the sand cores: each makes Refurb Life x (Refurbs Per Tool + 1) cores (coreboxMaterial), one box per core for the production, at the One Cavity Cost.

fields.name: Boxes
fields.formula: max(1, ceil({Lifetime Parts} / {Cores per Box})) * {Core Count}
